story_title: Fortinet FortiClient EMS SQL injection CVE-2023-48788 listed in the KEV catalog

provenance.note: Live end-to-end holdout v9 candidate, the contract-complete record demonstration, hard-required: decision=propose with at least one current claims row whose vendor, product identity (models_min>=1), matcher-supported affected range, and non-null supported fixed version are all backed by cited evidence. The official Fortinet PSIRT (FG-IR-23-215) states affected and fixed versions with machine-readable bounds (FortiClient EMS 7.0.x before 7.0.10, 7.2.x before 7.2.3) and the NVD configuration data carries structured versionStart/versionEnd fields, so the revision-5 extraction prompt (closed grammar for machine-readable bounds) makes an evidence-backed supported record achievable; any claim the model cannot ground routes to review or unknown instead. The stale-version grounding detector requires every version boundary of a supported range to appear in the cited evidence. KEV membership verified against the official CISA catalog feed on 2026-10-13 (catalogVersion 2026.10.08: Fortinet | FortiClient EMS | added 2024-03-25). Disjoint from the development datasets, every consumed holdout v1-v8, and the superseded first v8 candidate.
